About Irfan Global Estates & Developers

Who We Are

A real estate and property development business built on experience, trust and long-term relationships.

IRFAN GLOBAL ESTATES & DEVELOPERS is a real estate and property development business built on experience, trust and long-term relationships.

With roots dating back to 2001, the business was established under the leadership of Rana Irfan Javed, Founder & Managing Director.

Over the years, our focus has been on understanding the property market, connecting people with suitable real estate opportunities and providing professional guidance throughout their property journey.

Today, we aim to serve clients across Pakistan, with particular attention to overseas Pakistanis seeking reliable property assistance from abroad.

From residential plots and houses to apartments, commercial properties, construction and development opportunities, we aim to provide a comprehensive real estate experience.

Our Vision

To become a trusted name in Pakistan’s real estate and property development industry, connecting people with opportunities and contributing to sustainable growth through integrity, professionalism and long-term relationships.

Our Mission

To make property buying, selling and investment more accessible, transparent and convenient by providing reliable guidance, understanding client requirements and connecting them with suitable real estate opportunities across Pakistan.

Our Core Values

What guides our work

Transparency

Clear, honest guidance and straightforward communication throughout every property transaction.

Professionalism

Organised processes, responsive communication and responsible service.

Trust & Integrity

Building confidence through honest dealings, accountability and keeping client interests at the centre of our work.

Client Relationships

We believe in long-term relationships rather than one-time transactions.

Nationwide Opportunities

Connecting clients with residential, commercial and development opportunities across Pakistan.

Our Founder

Rana Irfan Javed

Founder & Managing Director

With a business journey dating back to 2001, Rana Irfan Javed established the foundation of the business around real estate, property opportunities and client relationships.

His vision is to build a trusted and professionally managed real estate and development company that serves clients locally and internationally.

Our Commitment

Informed, organised and accessible

Whether you are looking to buy your first property, sell an existing investment, explore commercial opportunities or discuss a construction project, IRFAN GLOBAL ESTATES & DEVELOPERS aims to make the process more informed, organised and accessible.

For our overseas clients, we understand that managing property matters from another country can be challenging. Our goal is to provide accessible communication, local coordination and clear guidance throughout the process.
